## 🟢 Current Situation
**What is the current experience?**
Describe how the feature works now and why it is suboptimal. Is it confusing, slow to use, or visually inconsistent?

## 💡 Proposed Improvement
**What is your suggestion?**
Describe the proposed change. How should it look or behave differently? 

## 🎯 The "Why" (User Impact)
**How does this improve the user experience?**
Explain the benefit. Does it save time, reduce errors, or make the interface more accessible?
